owner_disclosure: These comments come from owner clients of John Ellis's earlier timeshare rental company, gathered as reference feedback in 2012-2013 - before RentAtWyndham was founded in 2016. They describe working with John, not with RentAtWyndham.

owner.quote: John always does what he says he will do.
Level of service is excellent: communication is prompt and courteous. Money is paid promptly.
John does what he says, and we have confidence in him.
John and his team follow through and rent the points I make available for rental.
I have grown to trust John, and I feel he is totally on the side of his clients in wanting everything to work right.
I feel I can call John at any time, and he will talk with me for as long as it takes to address all of my questions and concerns.
I am happy with the rentals. They help with the maintenance fees. Payment comes in a timely manner. I had reservations about the company, but those were taken care of, and I am happy and content.
Positive returns for rentals. Extremely helpful personnel. Timely rentals. Cooperative spirit.

renter_disclosure: Renter comments are quoted from public posts in the Wisconsin Dells - Rental Deals Facebook group.
